## Safety Checklist

- [ ] No secrets, tokens, `.env`, logs, chat history, or private screenshots are included.
- [ ] Dangerous automation remains disabled by default.
- [ ] User confirmation is required for destructive or high-risk actions.
- [ ] Errors are clear and do not pretend success.
